assessment.summary: This is a review paper discussing the implications of sublethal insecticide exposure and the development of resistance on mosquito physiology, behavior, and pathogen transmission. It summarizes existing research on target-site mutations (kdr and Ace-1) and metabolic resistance in Anopheles and other mosquito genera.
